categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies address advertisement and proxy handling in src/net.cpp and src/netbase.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents nodes from self-advertising unreachable proxy exit IPs and polluting addrman across the network. Author evidence shows '55-76% of all tor exit nodes were present in various addrman snapshots' as fresh gossiped entries due to this behavior.
